description: Defines a UI component class for the Mobile Security section in the system console, including panels for general mobile security settings and Microsoft Intune integration, with methods for interaction and visibility checks.

classes.name: MobileSecurity
classes.description: Main class representing the Mobile Security section in the system console UI, providing access to various settings and panels.

classes.name: MicrosoftIntunePanel
classes.description: Panel class for Microsoft Intune related settings within the Mobile Security section.
